about_the_game:
You and Kurogi, your 266cm tall, yandere, goth sister, live together in an apartment in Tokyo, however, life with your older sister isn't as peaceful as one might think. Both you and Kurogi come from a family of sadistic, violent, yandere goths that express their love by abusing the person they love. Unfortunately for you, you didn't inherit your mother's giant, goth genes, but your sister did, and she shows you her sadistic, cruel, abusive, violent love every day. In truth, she treats you more like a slave and a punching bag rather than her brother, but you're okay with it, because that's just how your sister expresses her love.

Experience a day in the life of being a slave to your giant, sadistic, yandere, goth, delinquent older sister for a whole night.

  • ~2K words

  • Kinetic novel

  • 19 Unique character images

  • 22 Total images

  • A gallery with uncensored CG's of images in the game
